other_mijikenda: Mpweke shared with Duruma, Giriama, Swahili (Pakia)

teaser.en: Its branches become pestles, and one of its Digo names, mutsi, simply means 'pestle'.
teaser.sw: Matawi yake hugeuka michi, na mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo, mutsi, linamaanisha 'mchi' tu.

summary.en: *Mpweke* is a small relative of ebony found in coastal bushland and dry forest. Its branches are made into pestles for pounding grain.
summary.sw: *Mpweke* ni jamaa mdogo wa abunusi anayepatikana katika vichaka vya pwani na misitu mikavu. Matawi yake hutengenezwa kuwa michi ya kutwangia nafaka.

about.en: *Mpweke* is a small tree of the ebony family with dark bark and stiff leaves arranged one after another along the twig. Its small fruits sit in an enlarged calyx, a cup-like collar typical of the *Diospyros* ebonies.
about.sw: *Mpweke* ni mti mdogo wa familia ya abunusi wenye gome jeusi na majani magumu yaliyopangwa moja baada ya jingine kando ya kitawi. Matunda yake madogo hukaa ndani ya kikombe cha maua kilichopanuka, ukosi wenye umbo la kikombe ulio kawaida kwa abunusi za jenasi *Diospyros*.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and dry forest.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya pwani na misitu mikavu.

uses.en: The branches are made into pestles, the heavy pounding sticks used with a mortar.
uses.sw: Matawi hutengenezwa kuwa michi, vijiti vizito vya kutwangia vinavyotumika pamoja na kinu.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names: *mpweke*, shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili, and *mutsi*, which means 'pestle'. The Mgombato dictionary gives Swahili *mpweke* under *mkulu*, which it identifies as the jackal-berry, so the name may also be used for other ebonies.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo: *mpweke*, linalotumiwa pia na Waduruma, Wagiriama na Waswahili, na *mutsi*, linalomaanisha 'mchi'. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa jina la Kiswahili *mpweke* chini ya *mkulu*, ambao inautambulisha kuwa *jackal-berry*, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili pia linatumika kwa miti mingine ya abunusi.

reason.en: Another Diospyros; Mgombato links the names
reason.sw: Diospyros mwingine; Mgombato inayaunganisha majina haya

reason.en: Also used for pestles and mortars
reason.sw: Pia hutumika kwa michi na vinu

reason.en: Also named after the tool made from it
reason.sw: Pia umepewa jina kutokana na chombo kinachotengenezwa kwake
